stored_text.note: The only stored file is the MIIT transmittal notice (印发……的通知): metadata block, addressees, one sentence transmitting the Measures, the ten issuing bodies and the date 2026年3月20日. The text of the Measures (chapters, articles) is not stored; the notice page holds no attachment link in the stored HTML, and the gov.cn notice and PDF cited in verification.note were not archived. Title, issuing bodies, document number and dates can be checked; none of the summary's content claims can.

english_version.note: No English text in the stored file. Two web searches found no official English version of the final Measures. They found an unofficial CSET translation of the August 2025 consultation draft (https://cset.georgetown.edu/wp-content/uploads/t0672_draft_trial_ai_ethics_measures_EN.pdf), which is a different text, and an english.www.gov.cn news item of 3 Apr 2026 (a news report, not a translation). Both are leads only and were not stored.

title.source_quote: 标 题：工业和信息化部等十部门关于印发《人工智能科技伦理审查与服务办法（试行）》的通知
title.why: 办法 = Measures, 科技伦理审查 = science and technology ethics review, 与服务 = and services, （试行） = (Trial). original_title matches the title inside the book-title marks character for character. No official English title found.

summary_claims.claim: AI-specific ethics review regime (6 chapters, 37 articles)
summary_claims.original_quote: 现将《人工智能科技伦理审查与服务办法（试行）》印发给你们，请结合实际认真抓好落实。
summary_claims.literal_translation: The 'Measures for AI Science and Technology Ethics Review and Services (Trial)' are hereby issued to you; please implement them conscientiously in light of actual conditions.

summary_claims.claim: sets an expert re-review list for three high-risk categories of AI R&D (human-machine fusion, public-opinion mobilisation, highly autonomous decision-making in safety-critical settings)
issued by MIIT with NDRC, MoE, MOST, MARA, NHC, PBoC, CAC, CAS and CAST (issuing_body); signed 20 Mar 2026; MIIT drafting date 30 Mar 2026 (notes)
summary_claims.original_quote: 发文机关：工业和信息化部 国家发展改革委 教育部 科技部 农业农村部 国家卫生健康委 中国人民银行 国家网信办 中国科学院 中国科协
summary_claims.literal_translation: Issuing organs: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Health Commission, People's Bank of China, Cyberspace Administration of China, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China Association for Science and Technology [the same page has 成文日期：2026-03-30, 发布日期：2026-04-02 and the signature date 2026年3月20日]

key_terms.note: Same term as in the 2023 S&T Ethics Review Measures (科技伦理审查办法（试行）).
The register's summary also uses 'AI ethics review and service centres', which cannot be checked against stored text.

issues: The text of the Measures is not stored, so the summary's content (6 chapters, 37 articles, ethics committees and service centres, six review focuses, three high-risk categories, Art. 26 and Art. 37 in notes) cannot be checked.
verification.note cites a gov.cn notice and PDF that are not in local_copy; only the MIIT notice was archived (with role 'secondary', and no 'official' file).
note: Title, original_title, document number 工信部联科〔2026〕75号, the ten issuing bodies, the signature date 20 Mar 2026 and the MIIT 成文日期 30 Mar 2026 are all confirmed by the stored notice. The MIIT page gives 发布日期 2026-04-02, which agrees with the notes' 'published online 2-3 Apr 2026'.
